read_config_parse_ini: read an INI config file with duplicate keys into a nested dictionary using read_config
write_config_output_ini: write a nested dictionary back to INI format with sections and key-value pairs using write_config
inplace_edit_modify_config: read, modify, and write back an INI config file in one context manager using inplace_edit
read_config_duplicate_keys: parse INI lines where the same key appears multiple times under a section using read_config
write_config_list_values: write config values that are lists as repeated key=value lines in INI format using write_config
